circuit.name: Zeta DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Non-inverting step-up/step-down converter, the dual of the SEPIC (continuous output current, pulsating input current). Converts 12V input to 12V output at 1.2A (ideal D=0.5; D=0.526 covers the conduction and diode losses).

environment.description: 20ms with 100ns step, measured over the last 1ms (at 10ms the output is still rising and the ripple reads 6x too high)
